info.title: API.SH: Conrad
info.description: The Conrad API from API.SH: public Conrad data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What Conrad suggests while a shopper types: matching categories (with ids for /conrad/v1/search), popular categories, a detected brand and matching products (id, title, EAN, part number, image, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/conrad-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text typed so far.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop: de (conrad.de, default), at, ch, nl, be, fr, it, es, pl, cz, sk, si, hr, hu, dk, se or com (international, English).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Conrad's category tree: the top categories, or one category with its sub-categories (id, name, path, product count, image, link). Category ids work as `category` in /conrad/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/conrad-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category id (e.g. t08, c37381); leave out for the top level.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: How many levels of sub-categories, 1-3 (default 1).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop: de (conrad.de, default), at, ch, nl, be, fr, it, es, pl, cz, sk, si, hr, hu, dk, se or com (international, English).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Conrad live offers for many products
get.description:
Live offers for up to 50 Conrad products in one call: for each product every seller's price (gross and net), quantity price scales, stock, delivery and restock dates. `found` is false for products the shop does not sell.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/conrad-offers

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Article numbers, comma-separated (up to 50).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop: de (conrad.de, default), at, ch, nl, be, fr, it, es, pl, cz, sk, si, hr, hu, dk, se or com (international, English).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Conrad product: title, headline, brand, manufacturer part number, EAN, every seller's live offer (price gross and net, quantity price scales, stock, delivery and shipping dates, restock date), rating, description, features, what is in the box, technical attributes, category path, images, documents (data sheets, manuals, declarations), variants, accessories, alternatives, dimensions and weight, warranty and the manufacturer's contact details for product safety.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/conrad-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Article number (e.g. 2446476) or a conrad.de product link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop: de (conrad.de, default), at, ch, nl, be, fr, it, es, pl, cz, sk, si, hr, hu, dk, se or com (international, English).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Conrad Electronic product search with every filter the shop offers: product id, title, link, EAN, manufacturer part number, brand, image, key features and technical details, live price (gross and net), availability, stock, delivery date, the best seller and how many offers there are. `facets` lists the categories, product types, brands, sellers, price range, availability, store stock and the technical attributes of the results, with counts (pass names and values in `filters`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/conrad-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords (optional when category, brand, seller or filters is given).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only this category: an id such as 1101010, c37381, t08 or f79010534 (from /conrad/v1/categories, a suggestion, or `breadcrumb`).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brands, comma-separated, as in the brand facet (e.g. VOLTCRAFT,Fluke).

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Seller ids, comma-separated (CE001 is Conrad itself; others from a result's sellers or the sellerId facet).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price in the shop's currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price in the shop's currency.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true for products available online now.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Only products in stock at this store (a value from the storeAvailability facet, e.g. Mannheim).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters as name:value pairs separated by `;`, several values of one facet with `|` (e.g. productType:Hand-Multimeter;ATT_MEASURING-MODE:True RMS).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, up to 60 (default 30).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop: de (conrad.de, default), at, ch, nl, be, fr, it, es, pl, cz, sk, si, hr, hu, dk, se or com (international, English).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
